metadata.title: Clicked like I owed a stranger money and somehow landed that 1 baffling kill?! Valorant logic WTF
metadata.description:
Spam clicked like my mouse had a vendetta.
Enemy probably uninstalling from pure confusion.
Pretending that was skill for 0.11 seconds.
Click if your aim’s a glorious mess but kills still sneak in!

Tap if your aim’s a disaster but the game still says YES!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
